scientific_integrity: Exhaustive labeled-subset proof with two distinct complete finite algorithms and matching complete bitmap hashes; unindexed historical tables remain a priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for two explicitly defined sixteen-vertex graphs; no extension to all strongly regular graphs, no symmetry-orbit classification, and independent priority validation has not been conducted.
title: A total-dominating identifying-code polynomial separation of the Shrikhande and rook graphs
